dslRule:
<!id: ast-offset-comparison-fix>
<!description: Corrects offset comparison for Statement.getStartPosition() from exclusive to inclusive, fixing bug 41302 in JDT AST processing logic.>
<!severity: WARNING>
$offset < $s.getStartPosition() :: instanceof($s, "org.eclipse.jdt.core.dom.Statement")
=> $offset <= $s.getStartPosition()
;;
summary: Transforms `offset < s.getStartPosition()` to `offset <= s.getStartPosition()` for `org.eclipse.jdt.core.dom.Statement` instances, addressing an off-by-one bug in AST position comparison logic identified as bug 41302 in Eclipse JDT. The change makes the comparison inclusive.
